title: Storm Eunice — sting-jet low crossing southern Britain
notes: Eunice, 18 Feb 2022: ~966 hPa low tracking from south of Ireland across central/northern England to the North Sea; 122 mph gust at The Needles (England record). Position expectation is the midday-18th crossing area with a generous 5 deg tolerance. Confidence: high on date/depth, moderate on the instantaneous position (hence the wide tolerance).
